column3: Does not add Jacob’s sons or more.
Retains going down and does not add again.
Retains rising and does not add at once.
Retains the hand and all the days.
Retains arise rather than at once.
Retains the men rather than adding brothers.
Retains the rolling and falling upon them rather than only overpowering.
Retains the silver according to its weight and the hand.
Retains the hand and bringing down.
Retains peace and your God and the God of your father.
Retains bread and gift in the singular.
Retains the hand, singular gift, and repeated house.
Retains the two verbs of bowing.
Retains the warming of his compassion and seeking to weep.
